patterns.what_worked: Per-branch XML parsing with a namespace-aware parser settled the frames whose <Scripts> blocks matter (PaperDollFrame, InspectPaperDollFrame, InspectFrame, the shared GameTooltip and its template). The whole-tree sweep for InspectFrame_UnitChanged settled the dead post-hook. The verifier and both suites ran clean in the lane.
patterns.what_was_hard: Frame:HasScript and Frame:HookScript validation semantics are engine-side, and the two available pieces of evidence (the add-on's operator-witnessed note in Options.lua:594-613 and Blizzard's own Spinner.lua:8) point in opposite directions. The mirror cannot settle it, so it was escalated with a one-line in-game probe rather than reported as a defect.
patterns.skill_gap: Reading the XML with a namespace-aware parser from the start. The first probe pass reported Scripts=[] for every frame because the default namespace broke findall('./Scripts'); that would have produced a false 'no scripts declared' answer for the whole of A3 and A4.

escalation.recommendation: Before publishing, run /dump PaperDollFrame:HasScript("OnSizeChanged") in game. If false, the two OnSizeChanged hooks at TacoTip_Extras/Frames.lua:1356 and :1405 raise and the character/inspect surfaces die on all five clients; the fix is the same HasScript guard Options.lua:626-635 already uses. If true, nothing to do.
